obligation: G24 native affine2 design (from Grok archaeology, verified against our decoder + mlx).
why_new_kernel: Our geo_tpr64 kernels are SYMMETRIC (q*scale, no bias) and the unit test (qwen38_hybrid_decode.rs L4728) REFUSES group_size=32 (requires g64, bits 3/4). The SwiGLU family kernel is also q*scale. Affine needs a per-group fp16 BIAS and g32. So: new codec, new kernel -- do NOT edit HGRAVU01/geo_tpr64.

design.codec: HGRAVF01 (8-byte magic), schema hawking.gravity.affine_scale_bias.v1, representation affine_q2_group32_fp16_scale_bias, group_size 32, reconstruction w = float(q)*scale + bias, one fp16 scale + one fp16 bias per group.
design.container: reuse the HQ38M20 v1 128-byte catalog envelope (qwen38_hybrid_decode.rs:32-37); new codec id 5 in the packer (tools/qwen38_sub15_pack.py:84-88).
design.kernel: new affine2 g32 GEMV: unpack 2-bit codes from uint32 (16/word LSB-first), inline reconstruct w=q*scale+bias per group-32, accumulate. in-register dequant, no expand-to-dense.
design.integration: new MixedMlpNativeKind::AffineScaleBias; new match arms in the catalog-lane->kind mapping, role check, dispatch_uniform; new GpuUniform-like buffer carrying codes+scales+BIASES.
